run_Predictor_predict: run image classification inference using a chosen ViT or RegNet model on an input image
run_Predictor_setup: run the Predictor setup to load six pretrained ImageNet models and class mappings into memory
create_transform_image: create a normalized batched image tensor from a PIL image using resize, crop, and normalization
review_Predictor_predict: review the Predictor predict method to understand how top-k ImageNet class predictions are returned
refactor_Predictor_setup: refactor the Predictor setup method to lazy-load models on demand instead of loading all at once
